<definition>
<italic>safe investment, heirloom, family relic, treasure</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 2 (ref. to סגלה, Ex. XIX, 5) מה סְגוּלָּתֹו של אדם וכ' as the heirloom a man possesses is dear to him, so &c.; Pesik. R. s. 11, end. B. Bath. 52

<italic>s’gullah?</italic>… A scroll of the Law; … a date-tree. B. Kam. 87
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. ib. IX, 8, sq.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="O00116">
<head-word>סָגוּם</head-word>
<head-word>סָגֹוס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (σάγος, sagus, sagum) 
<italic>a coarse woolen blanket</italic>, mostly mentioned as 
<italic>a mattress</italic> to sleep on.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 277 ס' בלילה וכ' he must give him back the sagum for the night (B. Mets. IX, 13 את הכַּר). Sifré ib. 234 (ref. to Deut. XXII, 12, ‘wherewith thou clothest thyself’) פרט לס' this excludes the sagum. Kel. XXIX, 1. Ohol. XI, 3; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. סָגֹוסִין</plural-form>. Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. VII, 1 (ed. Zuck. סגסגין, oth. ed. סגסין, (corr. acc.; v. R. S. to Kel. XXIX, 1). Ib. V, 11 הסנסין (corr. acc.; v. R. S. to Kel. XXVIII, 8); ib. Neg. V, 14 סנסון (corr. acc.).—[Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Vayera 21 הוא מהלך בסגן Ms. R. (Ms. Parma בסגו, printed text פגן; Gen. R. s. 50, a. e. כפגן) read: מהלך בסָגוּן כפגן he travelled in a sagum like a commoner; (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Sagum.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> ; Saf.</definition>
<notes> of גאי; cmp. Job VIII, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to swell, rise, grow, spread, increase, thrive</italic>.</definition>
<notes>
<pgbrk id="pg954" />Targ. Lev. XIII, 12. Targ. Ex. I, 20. Targ. Ps. XCII, 13; a. fr.—Part. סָגֵי; f. סַגְיָא. Targ. O. Ex. IX, 9, sq. ed. Berl. (ed. Vienna, a. Y. סַגִּי). Targ. Lev. XIII, 42; a. fr.—Esth. R. introd. מן דסְגוֹ דייני שיקרא סְגוּן וכ' when faithless judges are numerous, false witnesses are frequent; מן דסגון … סָגִין ממונהן וכ' when informers are numerous, the cases of people’s properties being despoiled increase; Yalk. Esth. 1044 מדסְגָן … סְגִיאוּ; Yalk. Job 920 מדסגן … סְגִיאוּ. Sot. IX, 15 (49
<sup>b</sup>) יִסְגֵּא, v. חוּצְפָּא; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (= h. רַב) 
<italic>to be sufficient</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 6
<sup>a</sup> תִּסְגֵּי בתרי let it be enough with two judges.—[Targ. II Esth. III, 3 סגיתיה, read סַג יָתֵיה, v. סוּג ch.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַסְגֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to enlarge, increase, make great; to have much, do much</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. III, 16. Targ. Ps. XLIV, 13. Targ. Ex. XVI, 17. Targ. II Sam. XXII, 36; a. fr.—Yoma 88
<sup>a</sup> סָגֵי ומַ סְגֵּי he will grow and multiply (his descendants will be numerous).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סַגֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Targ. O. Num. XIV, 17 סַגִּי (imperative).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִסְתְּגֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be multiplied; to increase</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XLVIII, 16.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="O00121">
<head-word>סְגֵי</head-word>
<head-word>סְגָא</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Pa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> סַגֵּי (preced.; cmp. meanings of עָבַר) 
<italic>to progress, pass, walk</italic>. Snh. 95
<sup>a</sup> אורחא דבעא לסַגּוּיֵי … סְגָא וכ' a distance which one would have required ten days to make, he made in one day. Taan. 24
<sup>a</sup> ועד השתא הוא דסגָּאִי and I have been running until now. Sabb. 118
<sup>b</sup> דלא סָגֵינָא וכ' that I never walk a distance of four cubits with my head uncovered. Keth. 62
<sup>a</sup> לסַגּוּיֵי בהדיה, v. מְצִי I. B. Bath. 123
<sup>a</sup> ומי שרי … לסגויי ברמאותא are righteous men permitted to walk in the way of fraud (to deal fraudulently with a deceiver)? Erub. 18
<sup>b</sup> הי מינייהו סַגֵּי ברישא which of them went ahead?; זכר ס' וכ' the male (part of the double body) went ahead; Yalk. Ps. 887 סַגְיָא … מִסְתַּגְּיָא.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַסְגֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Targ. Jer. VIII, 6; XXIII, 10.—Sabb. 77
<sup>b</sup> עיזי מַסְגָּן ברישא goats take the lead. B. Kam. 60
<sup>b</sup> מַסְגֵּי להדיא passes openly, מחבי חבויי ומסגי passes secretly; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִסְתְּגֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be marched, be set in motion</italic>, v. supra.—Esp.</definition>
<notes> א' ליה 
<italic>he moved on</italic>. B. Bath. 74
<sup>a</sup> ולא הוה מִסְתְּגֵי לן and we did not start; לא מ' ליה he (the camel) will not start. B. Mets. 107
<sup>b</sup>, sq. מ' להו they will march along the river. Sabb. 7
<sup>a</sup> לא מ' להו בהדיא they do not pass there openly (with ease); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>numerous, large, great</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XXVI, 14 (O. ed. Vien. סַגְיָא). Targ. Is. LXIII, 7; a. fr.—Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי (חד כות' 1) נהור בנהור ס' light within a great light (many joys).—ס' נהור, v. נְהוֹר.—
<plural-form>Pl. סַגִּיאִין, סַגִּיאֵי, סַגְיֵי;</plural-form> f. סַגִּיאָן, סַגִּיָּין, סַגְיָין. Targ. Ps. III, 2, sq. Targ. Jud. VIII, 30 סגיאן (not … אין); a. fr.—B. Bath. 65
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. זמנין ס', v. זְמַן ch. B. Mets. 44
<sup>b</sup> באתרא דס' where money is plentiful, opp. דס' פירא where goods are plentiful; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> סַגִּי, סַגִּיא, also סַגִּין 
<italic>much, enough; greatly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Num. XVI, 3. Targ. II Esth. VI, 10 סַגִּיא באיש (not סַגְיָא); a. fr.—Y. Ber. V, 9
<sup>a</sup> bot., v. הֲגָא. Y. Shebu. VII, end, 38
<sup>a</sup> אנן עבדין טבות ס' מנכון we will do much better than you did. Y. B. Mets. II, 8
<sup>c</sup> bot. דהב ס' much gold. Y. Yoma IV, 41
<sup>d</sup> top חסר ס' it loses much (v. בְּרָרָא); Num. R. s. 12 a. fr.—Y. B. Mets. l. c. אתון רחמין … סוּגּוּ you love gold; very much; ib. סוּגּוּן.—[Yalk. Prov. 935 סגיי סוגייא, read: סייגין סייגא, v. סוּג I ch.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Saf. of דּוּר) 
<italic>to arrange, order</italic> (corresp. to b. h. ערך).</definition>
<notes> Pes. 54
<sup>a</sup> סוֹדְרָן על הכוס he pronounces them (the benedictions) in successive order over the cup. Yoma 45
<sup>b</sup> top שסודרן ע"ג המזבח that he must place them in order on the altar; שסודרן על הכבש … וסודרן that he must arrange them on the bridge or on the rim of the altar, until a large pile (of wood) is formed, when he must put them in order (on the altar); Tam. II, 1; a. fr.—Part. pass. סָדוּר; f. סְדוּרָה &c. Taan. 8
<sup>a</sup> בשביל משנתו שאינה ס' עליו it is because his learning is not properly systematised in his mind. Ber. 57
<sup>a</sup> עונותיו ס' לו his sins are arranged before him; מאי ס' ס' לימחל what does this mean? It means that they are arranged (ready) to be forgiven; Yoma 88
<sup>a</sup>. B. Bath. 69
<sup>a</sup> אבנים הס' לגדר stones arranged for erecting a fence, contrad. to צבורות piled up (v. סָוַר); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סִידֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same Tam. II, 3 same Tam. II, 3 לסַדֵּר אש המערכה to arrange the pyre, v. 
<xref rid="M02179">מַעֲרָכָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 4 כיצד מְסַדְּרִין לחם וכ' how did they arrange the showbread?; ib. also מַסְדִּירִים, מַסְדִּירִין (
<italic>Hif.</italic>); a. fr.—ס' שבח (cmp. ערך, Ps. V, 4, a. e.) 
<italic>to offer praise</italic>. Ab. Zar. 7
<sup>b</sup>; Ber. 32
<sup>a</sup> לעולם יְסַדִּר אדם וכ' one should always offer praise to the Lord first, and then pray (for what he needs). Ib. 34
<sup>a</sup> ראשונות דומה לעבד שמְסַדֵּר וכ' in the first three benedictions of the T’fillah one is like a servant that offers praise to his master; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְסוּדָּר. Men. 95
<sup>a</sup> במס' when everything in the Tabernacle was arranged, opp. במסולק when arrangements for moving were being made.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (corresp. to העריך, Lev. XXVII, 8) 
<italic>to assess a person’s value</italic> with reference to the vower’s ability to pay, whence: 
<italic>to exempt from seizure</italic> (bed, tools &c.; v. Arakh. VI, 3, sq.).</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 113
<sup>b</sup> כדרך שמסדרין בערכין כך מסדרין בבעל חוב as well as we allow an exemption from seizure in cases of vows, so we allow it in cases of debt; [Rashi quotes a Var. משרדין, v. שָׂרַד]. Ned. 65
<sup>b</sup> שמעת מינה אין מסדרין וכ' (Var. משיירין) from this you may deduce that no exemption is granted the debtor; B. Mets. 114
<sup>a</sup> מהו שיְסַדְּרוּ וכ' is a debtor allowed an exemption? Y. B. Kam. IX, 7
<sup>a</sup> top על מנת שלא לסַדֵּר מה וכ' with the condition that what my wife or my child wears is not to be exempted from seizure. Ib. אין מסדרין לו מאותו החפץ this special object is not exempted; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִסְדִּיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to arrange, establish the order of</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. l. c., v. supra. Ber. 28
<sup>b</sup>; Meg. 17
<sup>b</sup> ה' … על הסדר וכ' arranged the eighteen benedictions before Rabbi in the order in which they are to be recited. Sifra Tsav, Mill. כשם שה' משה וכ' as Moses arranged the service of the Tabernacle, so he arranged &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>a</sup> התם נביא הוא דקא מְסַדֵּר לשבחיה וכ' there (Neh. IX, 7 where Abram is used instead of Abraham) the prophet praises the Lord by referring to the past. Yoma 38

<sup>d</sup> נקרוץ נְסַדֵּר לאילין וכ' let us get up early and set in order those thorn-bushes (meaning, let us kill those men).—Shebu. 30
<sup>b</sup> דמחזי כמאן דמְסַדַּר דיניה Ms. M. (ed. דסַדַּר ליה לדיניה) he has the appearance of one whose case has been prearranged (with the judge; ed.: of one who has prearranged his case).</notes></sense>

<xref rid="O00199">preced.</xref>).</definition>

Sifra Tsav, Mill. הסדיר את הקרבנות כסִידְרָן the text arranges the sacrificial functions in their proper succession. Yoma 73
<sup>a</sup> sq. דוד שאל שלא כס' David did not put his questions (I Sam. XXIII, 1</notes></sense>

<number>1)</number>

<xref rid="unknown">פָּרָשָׁה</xref>) is resumed.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 30
<sup>b</sup> לס' פרשיות הוא חוזר the regular order of the Pentateuch sections is resumed; לס' הפטרות וכ' the regular order of Haftaroth is resumed; a. v. fr.—ס' זרעים the Order of Seeds, the first Order of the Mishnah; ס' מועד the Order of Festivals, the second Order of the Mishnah &c. Sabb. 31
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Keth. 106
<sup>a</sup> ס' (ד)אליהו, v. אֵלִיָּהוּ.—Esth. R. to 
<pgbrk id="pg959" />I, 9 ראש הס' as the first words of a pericope (Lev. R. s. 3 ראש סדרא).—
<plural-form>Pl. סְדָרִים,</plural-form> constr. סִדְרֵי, סִי'.—סדרי משנה, v. מִשְׁנָה.—Keth. 103
<sup>b</sup> ס' חכמה orders (rules) of wisdom; ס' נשיאות rules for the conduct of the Nasi’s office. Sabb. 53
<sup>b</sup> ס' בראשית the order of nature; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>regular homilies on the weekly portion</italic>. Sot. 49
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Job X, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition />
<notes> אם יש סדרים תופיע וכ' but if regular homilies are held, it (the earth) will come forth bright out of the dark.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
